about.title: Indonesian rattan, made with care for customers everywhere
about.description: Global Rotan brings together skilled Indonesian makers and buyers who value natural materials, honest construction and dependable service.
about.storyBody:
Rattan has been part of Indonesian homes for generations. Global Rotan was created to make this craft easier to buy for people and businesses around the world — with clear product information, practical customization and communication that respects your time.

We work closely with workshops that bend, bind and weave each frame by hand. Every order is checked for comfort, strength and finish before it is packed.

faq.q: Where does your rattan come from?
faq.a: We use selected natural rattan from partner forests in Sumatra and Kalimantan, chosen directly by our artisans in Cirebon before it is processed into weaving.

faq.q: Is every product really woven by hand?
faq.a: Yes. All weaving is done manually by experienced artisans — not machines — so every product has a slightly different weave character.

faq.q: Are colour or finishing samples available?
faq.a: Several finishes are available, including natural, dark brown and whitewash. Sample photos can be sent via WhatsApp before you decide.

faq.q: Can I order custom sizes or designs?
faq.a: Yes. Send your design references, dimensions and requirements via WhatsApp and our team will estimate the cost and production time.

faq.q: How long does a custom order take?
faq.a: On average 2–4 weeks depending on complexity and quantity, excluding shipping time.

faq.q: Is there a minimum order quantity?
faq.a: There is no minimum for single-item purchases. For wholesale or distributor partnerships, contact us to discuss quantities and special pricing.

faq.q: Do you ship to other cities and islands?
faq.a: Yes. We ship throughout Indonesia with partner freight services, including large items.
We handle export shipments. Please contact us to discuss the destination country, estimated costs and required documents.

faq.q: Are products packed safely for long-distance shipping?
faq.a: Yes, every product is wrapped in a protective layer and packed in a wooden crate or heavy-duty cardboard made for rattan goods before shipping.
We accept bank transfers and digital payments. Account details are sent after your order is confirmed via WhatsApp. This website does not accept online payments.

faq.q: Is a deposit required for custom orders?
faq.a: Custom orders usually require a deposit before production starts. The balance is paid when the product is finished or before it ships.

faq.q: How should I care for rattan furniture so it lasts?
faq.a: Avoid prolonged exposure to water and direct sunlight, dust regularly with a dry cloth or soft brush, and place it in a room with good airflow.

faq.q: Is rattan suitable for outdoor use?
faq.a: Natural rattan is best for covered terraces or semi-outdoor rooms. For fully outdoor use, ask us about weather-resistant finishing options.
Of course — visitors are welcome at our workshop in Kedung Malang, Kedung, Jepara, Central Java. Please contact us via WhatsApp first to make an appointment.

faq.q: Do you work with resellers or distributors?
faq.a: We are open to reseller and distributor partnerships. Please contact us to discuss pricing and regional availability.

shipping.title: Shipping & Export Information
shipping.intro: This page explains how Global Rotan prepares and ships orders. Specific terms are confirmed in each quotation.

sections.title: Order process
sections.body: Orders are confirmed only after you accept a written quotation. Prices shown on the website are indicative and do not constitute an offer.

sections.title: Production and lead times
sections.body: Ready-stock items can usually be prepared faster. Made-to-order and custom items follow the production schedule stated in your quotation. Lead times can change during peak seasons.

sections.title: Packing
sections.body: Standard export packing includes foam protection, plastic wrapping and cardboard cartons. Special packing, such as wooden crates or retail boxes, can be quoted on request.

sections.title: Domestic delivery (Indonesia)
sections.body: We can arrange delivery within Indonesia through trusted logistics partners. Costs depend on volume and destination.

sections.title: International shipping
sections.body: We support consolidated (LCL) and full container (FCL) shipments. Freight, insurance, import duties, taxes and customs clearance at the destination are the buyer’s responsibility unless agreed otherwise in writing.

sections.title: Documentation
sections.body: Commercial invoice and packing list are provided for every export shipment. Additional documents required by your country can be discussed before production.

sections.title: Inspection and claims
sections.body: Please inspect goods on arrival and report visible damage within 7 days with photos. We will review claims fairly according to the agreed shipping terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Global Rotan collects and uses personal information submitted through this website.

sections.title: Information we collect
sections.body: When you send an inquiry or message, we collect the details you provide, such as your name, company, email address, phone or WhatsApp number, country, shipping destination and the products you are interested in. Favorites and inquiry lists are stored in your own browser until you submit them.

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to respond to your requests, prepare quotations, arrange production and shipping, and improve our service. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Sharing
sections.body: We may share necessary details with logistics partners or service providers only to fulfil your request. These parties are expected to protect your information.

sections.title: Storage and security
sections.body: Data is stored with reputable cloud providers using access controls. Only authorized staff can view inquiries and messages.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.body: You may ask us to access, correct or delete your personal information by contacting us at the email address listed on this website.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use essential cookies and local storage to remember your language, currency, favorites and inquiry list. We do not use them for advertising.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: By using this website you agree to the following terms.

sections.title: Catalog information
sections.body: Product images, descriptions, dimensions and colors are provided for reference. Handmade products and natural materials may vary slightly from what is shown.

sections.title: Prices
sections.body: Prices on this website are indicative estimates and may change without notice. Final prices are confirmed only in a written quotation and depend on quantity, specifications, packaging, destination, taxes and shipping.

sections.title: No online transactions

sections.title: Orders
